verdict.rationale: Release changelogs are a fair question for a work-tracking tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents any Trello feature that generates a changelog or release notes. Generic automation claims, AI writing help, and Power-Up/REST API building blocks are adjacent capabilities or developer primitives, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
